description: Save a new code in the account and return its id, short link and a scan test. "url" (website link) and "vcard" (contact card) make changeable codes: they hold a short makemyqrcodes.com link, can be pointed somewhere new after printing, count their scans, and each uses one of the account's changeable codes (get_account shows how many are left). wifi, text, email, phone and sms codes are static and always free. Each type needs its own fields, named in each field's description. Web addresses are checked first: link shorteners, IP addresses and pages Google Web Risk flags are refused. Calling it twice makes two codes. Needs a key that can make and change codes. Use download_code afterward for the print file; use create_static_code when there's no key or nothing needs saving.

contact.description: type "vcard": the contact card people save. Needs first, last or org.

design.description: How the code looks. All optional; dark squares on a light background scan best.

ecc.description: error correction; higher survives more damage

frame_text.description: the label, e.g. "Scan for the menu"

margin.description: blank border in squares (4 is safest)

email_to.description: type "email": address the new email goes to

ending.description: Changeable codes: a custom link ending (makemyqrcodes.com/<ending>), 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Random if left out. Can't be changed later.

folder.description: Folder to put it in, any name; a folder exists once a code is in it

name.description: Shown in the account; made from the content if left out

phone_number.description: types "phone" and "sms": the number to call or text

sms_message.description: type "sms": text the message starts with

text.description: type "text": the message shown when scanned

type.description: url (website link) and vcard (contact card) are changeable; wifi, text, email, phone and sms are static

url.description: type "url": the web address the code opens, e.g. https://example.com/menu

wifi_password.description: type "wifi": password (leave out when wifi_security is "nopass")

wifi_security.description: type "wifi": WPA covers WPA2 and WPA3. Default WPA.

name: create_code

changeable_codes_left.description: A number, or "unlimited" while plans are switched off

folder.description: Left out when the code isn't in a folder

holds.description: Where it points, or what it holds, in a few words

id.description: Use it as "code" in get_code, update_code and download_code

last_scan_at.description: ISO time of the latest scan

link.description: Changeable codes: the short link the printed code holds

locked.description: true when a lapsed plan locks editing; the code still works

min_print_size.description: Smallest printed width that scans reliably

scan_test.description: Whether our reader decoded the saved design

scans.description: Changeable codes: scans of all time, automated checks left out

warnings.description: Design problems worth fixing, e.g. low contrast

title: Make a code
